title: f-String Greeting
description:
Store `first = "John"` and `last = "Doe"`. Use an f-string to print `Hello, John Doe!`.

**Expected output:**
```
Hello, John Doe!
```
starterCode:
first = "John"
last = "Doe"
# Use an f-string to print the greeting
hint: Use f"Hello, {first} {last}!" — f-strings let you embed variables directly in the string.
